editorial: You follow Alex, Marty, Melman, and Gloria as they chase the penguins and chimps across Europe after a wild Monte Carlo casino heist. When fierce French animal-control officer Capitaine Chantel DuBois starts hunting them, the gang hides out in a traveling circus to stay safe. The movie is bright, fast, and packed with silly jokes that keep kids and adults laughing. The circus setting gives the story a fresh look, with colorful acts and big energy from start to finish. You will enjoy the lively voice work and the nonstop action, though the plot stays pretty simple and some jokes repeat. If you want a fun family night with lots of color and laughs, this one delivers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: The circus puts on a huge show in London that wins over the crowd and earns a contract to tour America. DuBois tries to capture Alex, but the circus animals rescue him and send her away. Instead of going back to the zoo, Alex and his friends choose to stay with the circus and travel the world together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family adventures and silly humor.
